posts.title: What a drone shoot actually costs
posts.caption:
A licensed drone operator runs about $250 to $550 a shoot, weather permitting. An AI aerial-style clip costs a few dollars of video credits.

They are not the same thing. Real footage shows the real lot. AI shows a beautiful guess. Know which one your listing needs.

Made with AI. learn.aireestate.com

#realestatemarketing #dronevideo #realtorlife

posts.title: What AI gets wrong
posts.caption:
These models sometimes invent things: a window, a roofline, a view past the trees. Fine in a lifestyle post. Not fine in a property ad.

Check every frame. You're the licensee, not the software.

Part One teaches the method and the check. $67 once.
